scene.title: Claude gets hands: a lookup_customer tool, and the bad emails it sometimes sends
scene.sceneHtml:
TicketFlow: Week 5

Agents need to look up customer data mid-conversation. You define a lookup_customer tool with name, description, and JSON schema. Claude starts calling it automatically. But occasionally it sends malformed emails. You add argument validation to catch this before the DB query.

takeaways: The loop: Claude emits tool_use, your app executes it, you append tool_result as a user message, repeat until stop_reason is end_turn.
Model picks the wrong tool or calls it at the wrong time? Fix the description and schema, not max_tokens; schema alone never decides when.
JSON Schema validates shape only; add business-rule checks (email format, ID exists, amount > 0) in your dispatcher before executing.
When validation fails, return a tool_result carrying the error message instead of raising; Claude reads it and adapts (retry, ask, re-plan).
